dockerfile_copy_all.benefit: Smaller image, no accidental secret exposure in container layers.

dockerfile_unpinned_base.benefit: Reproducible builds, protection against supply chain attacks.

eval_injection_php.benefit: Prevention of remote code running (OWASP A03, CWE-94).

xss_blade_unescaped.risk: {!! $var !!} outputs unescaped HTML in Laravel Blade, allowing XSS if user input is included.

steps.action: Locate the vulnerable code pattern in the file
Use {{ $var }} (auto-escaped) instead of {!! !!}. Only use {!! !!} for trusted static HTML.
Run the audit again to verify the finding is resolved

xss_blade_unescaped.benefit: Prevention of XSS via Blade templates (OWASP A03, CWE-79).

xss_echo_php.title: XSS via echo (PHP)
xss_echo_php.risk: Echoing $_GET/$_POST/$_REQUEST without escaping allows cross-site scripting.

steps.action: Locate the vulnerable code pattern in the file
Use htmlspecialchars($var, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') for all user output.
Run the audit again to verify the finding is resolved

xss_echo_php.benefit: Prevention of XSS attacks (OWASP A03, CWE-79).

xss_innerhtml.risk: Direct innerHTML manipulation can inject malicious scripts.

steps.action: Locate the vulnerable code pattern in the file
Use HtmlEncoder.Encode() or Razor auto-escaping (@Model.Value). Only use Html.Raw for trusted static content.
Run the audit again to verify the finding is resolved

xss_raw_html.benefit: Prevention of XSS attacks (OWASP A03, CWE-79, SCS0029).

xss_react_dangerous.risk: dangerouslySetInnerHTML injects raw HTML into the DOM, allowing XSS if user input is not sanitized.

steps.action: Locate the vulnerable code pattern in the file
Sanitize content with DOMPurify before injection, or use React's default JSX escaping.
Run the audit again to verify the finding is resolved

xss_react_dangerous.benefit: Prevention of XSS in React components (OWASP A03, CWE-79).

xss_svelte_html.benefit: Prevention of XSS in Svelte components (OWASP A03, CWE-79).

html_invalid_aria_role.title: Empty ARIA role attribute

steps.action: Locate all role="" occurrences in HTML templates
Replace with a valid ARIA role matching the element's purpose (e.g. role="dialog", role="navigation", role="button")
Verify with a screen reader or axe-core that the element is correctly announced

html_invalid_aria_role.benefit: WCAG 4.1.2 compliance — correct semantics for assistive technologies.

html_aria_hidden_focusable.title: Focusable element hidden with aria-hidden

steps.action: Identify all focusable elements (a, button, input, select, textarea) with aria-hidden="true"
Add tabindex="-1" to remove from keyboard flow while keeping aria-hidden, or remove aria-hidden and add an accessible label instead
Test keyboard navigation: Tab must not land on elements hidden from assistive technologies

html_aria_hidden_focusable.benefit: WCAG 1.3.1 and 4.1.2 compliance — coherent keyboard navigation for screen reader users.

html_viewport_zoom_disabled.title: User zoom disabled in viewport meta tag

steps.action: Find the <meta name="viewport"> tag in the HTML head
Remove user-scalable=no from the content attribute. Keep only: width=device-width, initial-scale=1
Test on a mobile device that pinch-to-zoom and browser zoom work correctly

html_viewport_zoom_disabled.benefit: WCAG 1.4.4 compliance — users can resize text up to 200% without loss of functionality.

html_select_missing_label.title: Select element without accessible label

steps.action: Identify all <select> elements without an associated <label> or aria-label
Add <label for="select-id"> pointing to the select's id, or add aria-label="Description" directly on the select element
Verify with axe-core or a screen reader that the select is correctly announced with its label

html_select_missing_label.benefit: WCAG 1.3.1 and 4.1.2 compliance — all form controls have an accessible name.

html_input_button_empty.title: Button input without value attribute

steps.action: Find all <input type="submit">, <input type="reset">, <input type="button"> without a value attribute
Add a descriptive value attribute (e.g. value="Submit form") or replace with <button type="submit">Submit form</button>
Verify the button is announced correctly by a screen reader

html_input_button_empty.benefit: WCAG 4.1.2 compliance — every interactive control has an accessible name.

html_autocomplete_invalid.title: Non-standard autocomplete attribute value

steps.action: Find all inputs with autocomplete set to non-standard values (yes, true, false, enabled, disabled)
Replace with a valid HTML5 autocomplete token matching the field purpose: email, username, current-password, new-password, name, tel, off, on, etc.
Test autofill in a browser to confirm the correct data is suggested

html_autocomplete_invalid.benefit: WCAG 1.3.5 compliance — input purpose is identifiable, enabling correct autofill for all users.

html_th_scope_missing.title: Table header without scope attribute

steps.action: Find all <th> elements in HTML tables without a scope attribute
Add scope="col" for column headers and scope="row" for row headers
Test with a screen reader to verify the table is correctly navigable

html_th_scope_missing.benefit: WCAG 1.3.1 compliance — table structure is programmatically determinable.

html_missing_main_landmark.title: Missing main landmark element

steps.action: Check if the page has a <main> element or an element with role="main"
Wrap the primary page content in <main>...</main>. Use only one <main> per page
Test with a screen reader: verify users can skip to main content with a keyboard shortcut

html_missing_main_landmark.benefit: WCAG 1.3.6 and 2.4.1 compliance — users can bypass navigation and jump to main content.

html_invalid_lang_value.title: Non-BCP-47 lang attribute value

steps.action: Find all lang attributes using plain language names (french, english, spanish, german, etc.)
Replace with valid BCP 47 codes: fr, en, es, de, it, pt, nl, pl, ar, zh, ja, ko, ru, sv, etc.
Validate using the W3C Language Tag checker or a screen reader pronunciation test

html_invalid_lang_value.benefit: WCAG 3.1.1 and 3.1.2 compliance — correct language codes enable proper screen reader pronunciation.

html_video_missing_captions.title: Video without caption track

steps.action: Find all <video> elements without a <track kind="captions"> child element
Create a WebVTT (.vtt) or SRT subtitle file for the video. Add <track kind="captions" src="file.vtt" srclang="fr" label="Français"> inside the <video> tag
Test in a browser that captions display correctly when enabled

html_video_missing_captions.benefit: WCAG 1.2.2 compliance — all prerecorded synchronized media has captions.

xml_bomb.title: XML Bomb (Billion Laughs) via unprotected XML parser
xml_bomb.risk: Parsing user-supplied XML with the standard library (xml.etree, xml.dom, xml.sax) without disabling DTD entity expansion enables Billion Laughs attacks — a small payload causes exponential memory consumption and denial of service (CWE-776, CWE-400).

steps.action: Locate stdlib XML parser calls (xml.etree, xml.dom, xml.sax) that consume user-supplied data

Replace the import with defusedxml (e.g. import defusedxml.ElementTree as ET), a drop-in replacement that disables entity expansion by default. Alternatively, reject any XML input containing a DOCTYPE declaration before parsing.
Run the audit again to verify the finding is resolved

xml_bomb.benefit: Prevents XML bomb (Billion Laughs) denial-of-service attacks.
